Etern was home to a scientific lab where biological experiments took place. Many new lifeforms were created here among which are the famous Baboon Hawks. In more recent times they have been working on "Project Nutcracker" as instructed. Rumors are that they used human subjects for emotional manipulation using certain toy masks.

> Moon Map

> Moon Info

POPULATION: Transformed.

CONDITIONS: Warm, Dry sandy terrain, supports plant life such as cactaceae and rarely polypodiophyta.

FAUNA: A thriving ecosystem, creatures support agressive behaviour.

> Environment

Etern is a deserted moon. It has polypodiophyta scattered around the moon with cactaceae spread about. Etern has lots of steep hills that you can't walk up. After the bomb goes off at 5pm the place turns into a barren wasteland where the cactaceae are turned into molten rock from the explosion with heavy amounts of fog and dust from the explosion making it hard to see.

> Weather

Etern can experience Rainy, Foggy, Stormy, Flooded, Eclipsed, Earthquakes, Forsaken, Hallowed, Hurricane, or Minefield weather by default.

> Moon Exclusive Content

Inside & Outside Ambience

On Etern you can hear two ambiences. One plays inside while the other one plays outside.

Outside Ambience

Inside Ambience

Bomb

Etern's exterior has a siren that will go off at 05:00pm outside a fence, which can also be heard while inside the interior. At 06:00pm the siren will stop and a bomb will be dropped. This bomb doesn't do any damage regardless of proximity, but makes everything foggy outside and hard to see. By around 10:00pm the dust will settle.

Ambience

Etern's interior plays unique ambient sounds, primarily to trick the player into thinking there is danger. For example, a Nutcracker can be heard scanning an area in the distance as well as the distant spring of a Coil-Head as if it had been spotted.

Altar (Mysterious Object's Slot)

Etern's exterior also has an altar where a mysterious object can be placed. To reach it, walk straight forward from the front of the ship and it'll be slightly to the right in some plants and grass. This mysterious object is a Brooding seed that can found in a hidden chamber on the exterior of Berunah. Placing the seed will cause a warning message to appear that says "A Cosmic Entity of unknown power has turned it's focus towards this planet."

This dramatically alters the terrain on the exterior, causes several tentacles to appear on the exterior that deal 20 damage per hit on contact, and visually alters the interior. This persists until players are fired unless seeds are also placed on the exteriors of Filitrios, Fission-C, Gloom, and Utril, in which case the changes become permanent on that save file.


> Progression

Unlocked By

Logging "Geoffrey's log 4" found on the exterior of Junic.
Alternatively, inserting the Etern videotape that randomly spawns as scrap within the interiors of Calist, Fission-C, Oldred, Polarus, or Trite into the projector in Galetry.

Unlocks

Dune: Craft a "Blank floppy disc" on Galetry, insert it into the Floppy Disc Machine on Etern's exterior, and log "Dune floppy disc".
Glace: Log "Geoffrey's log 3" found on the exterior.
Gratar: Gratar videotape that randomly spawns as scrap within the interior.
Oldred: Oldred videotape that randomly spawns as scrap within the interior.

> Lore

Etern is also referred to as the "Death Labs".

Geoffrey's log 3

- continues the reversed storyline of Agent Geoffrey, unlocking Glace when logged. He comments on the state of the war, his family, the vanishing of Cosmocos, and the development of some kind of mind control technology using Cosmic Growth.

Text ⁠
It’s been over one hundred and twenty days since my meeting on Polarus and the devastating Catalyst of this Grand War we now find ourselves in.
As we had foreseen, the military of Titan was not pleased with the initial attack and launched a counter attack within the same week.
It only escalated from there..
However,

I’m pleased to report that my family, my wife, and my children have all safely made it to Trite, as promised..
I do hope the trip wasn’t as bad as mine have been.
They were moved in secrecy for their own protection. So unfortunately I am unable to contact them..
At least that’s what I was told when I tried my hardest to do so.
Maybe it’s for the better.

I have only a few more missions to complete before I can visit my family again.
Speaking of which,

The teams we send out to Cosmocos have vanished..
And..
So has the entire moon.
It vanished from the radars entirely. Which seems impossible and yet is true.

This happened only days after they found something.. incredible that would’ve been the key to our victory.
All that returned was a confused and mad Commander Cunningham who supposedly tried to sabotage the operations. And a large amount of so-called “Cosmic Growth”.
Anyways,

I have been tasked to guide a group of scientists here with the creation of manipulative weapons using the aforementioned Cosmic Growth.
They’ll grow into the brain of whoever it will be applied to and we’ll supposedly have full control over them.
Think of it as a mind controlling parasite.
It will hopefully aid us in this war.
Then once that’s done I will vanish in the night for my next task.

Agent G- Signing off.

Tape Player Logs & Protocol Wipeout

Additionally, Tape player protocol wipeout and Tape player logs can randomly spawn as scrap within the interior. They tell the rest of the story of the scientist that created G.A.R.Y., the AI sold to the company on Gratar. They talk about the installation of a nuke on Etern, a former project that created Baboon Hawks, a new project for the creation of Nutcrackers, and the aforementioned manipulative weapons resulting in the creation of Masked. The scientist died to a Nutcracker via gunshot.

Protocol Wipeout

Text ⁠
Year 154, day 12.

Today is a scary day.
Protocol wipeout was approved and the nuclear bomb will be installed tomorrow.
Knowing where it came from I no longer feel quite as safe here.
I can only imagine what could go wrong.
Worse.
How it could ruin years of research and experimentation!
In case you don't know..
Protocol wipeout is only called during.. events of disaster.
Destroying.
Everything.
As much as I am facinated with the craft, I refuse to let it destroy all we've done.
Perhaps I could modify some of its components.
We'll see.
Now that project hawk is complete, we have received plans for new machines that will be used in the Grand War that just broke out.
It will be called, Project Nutcracker.
I'm excited.
Me out.

Text ⁠
Year 154, day 136.

Business as usual.
Project nutcracker is well on the way.
These droids are getting more advanced by the day.
Especially since Geoffrey joined us a week ago.
Great stuff.
Me out.

Text ⁠
Year 154, day 139.

Uhh giants are still as prevalent as allways.
Uh.
We started to experiment with emotional manipulation alongside project nutcracker.
We just need the proper items to uh bind it to.
Me out.

Text ⁠
Year 154, day 146.

We used masks.. Big mistake.
They seem to get stuck to their wearers..
uh..
No other side effects have been noted.

I haven't seen it myself but I've heard project nutcracker was a succes!
It sounds like they're actually alive!
uh..
We also noticed that Geoffrey went missing recently.
We are looking into that.
Me out.

Tape Player Log 4 / Scientist Log 4

Text ⁠
Year 154, day 15.. something.

I am on the run.
Those masks.. took them.
They're not them anymore.
They took my team! Converted half of them!
The nutcrackers are not droids like I thought.
I.. I saw one of them.
It shot me.. right in the chest before I got here.
I'm bleeding out.
I think the nutcrackers..
They're my coworkers..
Or what's left of them.
I think those masked men..
I think they..

*Gunshot*

Etern Videotape

If players find the Etern videotape randomly as scrap within the interiors of other moons and insert it into the projector in Galetry, the story of Captain Commander Cunningham continues. Confusingly, Etern is recorded as "Tape 3" while Atlantica is recorded as "Tape 2" by Cunningham. On the other hand, Cunningham's travel log 2 explicitly states that Cunningham routed to Atlantica after visiting Etern. Either way, this chronologically happened some time between Cunningham routing to Infernis and Cunningham routing to Acidir.
This videotape can be found on Calist, Fission-C, Oldred, Trite and Polarus.

Text ⁠
Tape 3, Etern.

This is Captain Cunningham.
I have not been able to record much here and we will be leaving as soon as possible.

Our trip to Etern has been an absolute disaster. I’ve seen more nutcrackers searching for us than there are grains of sand in this desert.
We’ve lost many and I’m not keen on losing any more of us.

Etern gets an S+.
I highly discourage anyone from going here.
Cunningham, signing off.
